ValidationRule.description: User with Sales, Sales Manager profile can only update the Pipeline Source value to : Internal Referral Outbound ABM Partner Referral Events
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISCHANGED(Pipeline_Source__c), AND(ISNEW(),From_Lead_VGW_Manual_Conversion__c == FALSE)) && OR(ISPICKVAL(Pipeline_Source__c,'Declared Interest'), ISPICKVAL(Pipeline_Source__c,'Undeclared Interest')) && CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Sales')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only update the Pipeline Source value to Internal Referral/Outbound/ABM/Partner Referral/Events
